rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. The spouse variants ("or your spouse if filing jointly"; "only one spouse is required to have a valid SSN"; the joint-return branches of Steps 2 and 4; "other than your spouse if filing jointly" in the tie-breaker caution; "younger than you (or your spouse if filing jointly)") arise only on a joint return, and married filing statuses are refused (`s3.married`). The `sa.dependent` gate also names a dual-status alien, which the instructions refuse for the dependents section too (i1040gi p. 18, Step 2, question 4, and the nonresident and dual-status alien rules); a single filer answers for themself alone. No change to the data.
